text_blocks.snippet: No, having COVID-19 does not provide long-lasting immunity. While recovering from an infection, your body develops antibodies that may protect you from reinfection for a few months. However, the effectiveness of these antibodies wanes over time, and new variants of the virus can evade them. Therefore, it is possible to get infected with COVID-19 again even after having had it previously.
